templates.name: Javascript - Vue
templates.raw:
FROM node:20.11.0 as build-stage
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./

RUN npm install
COPY ./ .
RUN npm run build

FROM nginx as production-stage
RUN mkdir /app
COPY --from=build-stage /app/dist /app
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

templates.name: Python - pip - Fast API
templates.raw:
FROM python:3.10

WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt requirements.txt
RUN pip3 install -r requirements.txt
RUN pip3 install uvicorn
COPY . .
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["uvicorn", "app:app", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=80"]

templates.name: Python - poetry - Fast API
templates.raw:
FROM python:3.11.6-slim

ENV POETRY_VERSION=1.8.3 \n    POETRY_HOME=/opt/poetry \n    POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=1 \n    POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_CREATE=1 \n    POETRY_CACHE_DIR=/opt/.cache

ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/code/.venv \n    PATH="/code/.venv/bin:$PATH"

WORKDIR /code

RUN python3 -m venv $POETRY_HOME \n    && $POETRY_HOME/bin/pip install -U pip setuptools \n    && $POETRY_HOME/bin/pip install poetry==${POETRY_VERSION}

ENV PATH="${PATH}:${POETRY_HOME}/bin"

# COPY ./pyproject.toml ./pyproject.toml
COPY . .

RUN poetry install && rm -rf $POETRY_CACHE_DIR


EXPOSE 80


CMD [ "python", "-m", "uvicorn", "app:app", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=80"]
